subject: Post-call: on-prem/air-gapped deployment — hardware & offline ops clarifications
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@medtech-ai.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-14T15:20:00-08:00
Subject: Post-call recap & next steps — on-prem/air-gapped qualification

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the call today — quick recap and next steps so we have a single source of truth. High-level we heard that MedTech AI's requirements tilt strongly toward a fully isolated, on-prem/private deployment (air-gapped or VPC with strict egress controls). A few of the things we promised to follow up on:

- Hardware sizing guidance for initial pilot (expected 10 qps at p50 <120ms, burst to 50 qps).
- Offline upgrade/patch process (how you want us to deliver OS/agent/patch artifacts into an air-gapped site).
- Backup & restore / telemetry controls for customers who cannot share logs offsite.
- Procurement timeline and preferred vendors/contact.

Attaching the HW questionnaire we discussed — if you can have the infra/procurement folks return the medtech-hw-specs-v2.xlsx with rack power & OS baseline, that will let us validate a deploy plan.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Procurement fills out the HW sheet (attached).
2) Tech deep-dive with your infra lead + our on-prem eng (Soojin) — 60m to cover upgrade mechanics and maintenance windows.
3) Draft Mutual Action Plan (timeline + SOW + NDA) to align procurement & legal.

Can you confirm who in your team will own the HW spreadsheet and any constraints on bringing USB / physical media onto the site for upgrades?

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Elena Soto <elena@medtech-ai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@medtech-ai.com>, Procurement <procurement@medtech-ai.com>
Date: 2026-02-15T10:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — on-prem/air-gapped qualification

Karthik — thanks for the clear note. A few clarifications from our side after internal sync:

- We are evaluating a two-phase approach: Phase 1 = isolated private deployment in our primary data center (no internet egress allowed); Phase 2 = consider dedicated cloud peering for DR in a separate zone.
- Hardware: procurement will complete the sheet — primary constraint is N+1 power at rack level, BMC access must be isolated but available on an internal mgmt VLAN.
- Upgrades/patching: Our security policy disallows direct internet pulls. We prefer either: (A) signed artifact bundles delivered via secure file transfer to an internal staging host, or (B) physical media handoff (USB or sealed media) with documented chain-of-custody.
- Maintenance window: we can offer a weekly 2-hour window (UTC-8, Tue 03:00-05:00) for non-critical patching, but prefer monthly for anything that requires system restarts.

Procurement (cc'd) will own the HW sheet. I'll ask Marco to return the first draft by EOD Monday (2026-02-16). We attached medtech-hw-specs-v2.xlsx in this thread.

For the tech deep-dive, could your engineer cover: artifact signing, offline upgrade steps, and KV-cache persistence/restore behavior?

Cheers,
Elena
Director, Infrastructure — MedTech AI
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@medtech-ai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-16T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — on-prem/air-gapped qualification

Hi Elena — thanks, this is helpful. A few operational questions ahead of the deep-dive so we can tailor the agenda:

1) Artifact delivery: do you have an existing secure drop (sftp with internal bastion) or will we need to plan for sealed media? If sealed media, who is the on-site receiver and what is the chain-of-custody process?

2) Boot/firmware policy: does your team permit RFID-tagged replacement drives or do we need to bring new drives through procurement only? Any restrictions on remote BMC access (IP allowlist ranges)?

3) Patch acceptance testing: do you run a staging cluster on identical hardware for acceptance? If not, we should include a QA signoff step in the MAP where we ship a read-only artifact to a staging host first.

If you prefer, we can split the deep-dive into two 45m blocks: (A) patch/artifact delivery & signing; (B) runtime behavior, persistence, and restore. Suggested dates: Tue 2026-02-24 or Thu 2026-02-26, UTC-8.

Best,
Soojin
Staff Engineer, On-Prem Deployments | Redwood Inference
From: Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@medtech-ai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Elena Soto <elena@medtech-ai.com>
Date: 2026-02-17T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — on-prem/air-gapped qualification

Soojin / Karthik — procurement here. Quick answers:

- We have an internal SFTP drop (sftp.medtech.local) behind the bastion. We'll create a short-lived account for Redwood to upload signed bundles. Protocol is to deliver SHA256 + PGP-signed manifest for each bundle.
- Chain-of-custody: we can accept sealed USB media but it must be logged against an MR number and signed by on-site ops. I'll put the contact in the HW sheet (field: on_site_ops_contact).
- Staging: yes, a 3-node staging cluster exists with identical disk/firmware baseline. We expect a QA signoff prior to production upgrade.
- Timeline: procurement can return the completed HW sheet by 2026-02-16 (Marco included); procurement lead is Marco Ruiz (marco.ruiz@medtech-ai.com).

Attached the initial medtech-hw-specs-v2.xlsx with answers in-line where available.

Regards,
Marco
Procurement Manager | MedTech AI
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Soto <elena@medtech-ai.com>, Marco Ruiz <marco.ruiz@medtech-ai.com>, Procurement <procurement@medtech-ai.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & next steps — on-prem/air-gapped qualification

Thanks Marco / Elena — this is great and answers most of our immediate questions. Next items from Redwood:

- I'll drop a short Mutual Action Plan PDF (rdw-offline-deploy-checklist.pdf) that maps milestone dates: tech deep-dive, pilot provisioning, QA signoff, and first-production window.
- Soojin: please prepare a 45m agenda focused on artifact signing, upload flow to sftp.medtech.local, and the staging acceptance test (include a rollback playbook).
- Legal/Procurement: I'll circulate an NDA + a draft SOW after we align on the MAP; procurement, please confirm any PO templates/terms we should use.

Proposed tech-deep-dive slot: Thu 2026-02-26 10:00-10:45 PT (UTC-8). If that works for everyone, I will send a calendar invite.

Elena / Marco — any objections to Redwood preparing the signed artifact packaging guide and a sample PGP manifest prior to the deep-dive? We can demo a local upload to your SFTP during the call.

Appreciate it — looking forward to the deep-dive.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
